name: Sacedón (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre, charged with a smaller white triangle at the hoist.
history: The arms of Sacedón were approved on 11 June 1985 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 18 June 1985; the flag is yellow, of 2:3, with a red triangle based on the hoist with its apex at the centre of the cloth, charged with a smaller white triangle also based on the hoist.
